LanguageData.GJL_IC_ChargeDesc: Charge the chosen target. Distant targets are approached first; within 9 cells the iron cavalry speeds up to 1.5x and charges.\n\nThe distance run (3-8 cells) boosts the first lance thrust to 1.5-2.5x damage, and a hit stuns the target for 1.5-3 seconds. Cooldown 15 seconds.
LanguageData.GJL_IC_AutoChargeDesc: Charge automatically during melee when conditions allow. When already engaged, briefly fall back and re-charge only if it gains damage.
